title: Hill Country & Beach
summary: Cool mountain scenery, tea plantations and waterfalls, then golden beaches on the south coast. The perfect blend of relaxation and adventure.

includes.heading: What the journey includes.
includes.body: Everything below is arranged before you land, so the days ask nothing of you beyond turning up. Flights and visas sit outside the plan, and we will say so clearly in the proposal.

items.title: Accommodation
items.body: Eight nights, from Myst by Cinnamon in Kandy and Araliya Green in the hills to Anantara Peace Haven and Jetwing Lighthouse on the coast.

items.title: Activities
items.body: The Temple of the Tooth, Horton Plains, Little Adam’s Peak, the Nine Arches Bridge and Ravana Falls, and two days of jeep safaris in Yala.

items.title: Meals
items.body: Breakfast every day, plus the meals that are part of a stay or a long drive. The rest stays open, because eating out is half the trip.

items.title: Transfers and driver
items.body: Airport pick-up and drop-off, and the same driver and vehicle for the whole route, from the hills down to the sea.

itinerary.heading: From the tea to the sea.
itinerary.lede: Open a day to see what it holds and where you sleep.

days.title: Sri Lanka’s Last Kingdom
days.body: Discover Sri Lanka’s cultural heart with the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, scenic Kandy Lake, lush hills, and rich traditions.

days.title: Little England in the Clouds
days.body: Explore endless tea plantations, misty mountains, scenic waterfalls, Gregory Lake, charming colonial buildings, and the breathtaking beauty of Horton Plains. A perfect escape for nature, adventure, relaxation, and unforgettable views.

days.title: Ridgelines and Railway Bridges
days.body: A day on foot: Little Adam’s Peak, the Nine Arches Bridge and Ravana Falls, with cafe hopping to finish.

days.title: Down to Leopard Country
days.body: Two days of jeep safaris in leopard country, plus elephants and birdlife. Mornings for the animals, afternoons by the pool.

days.title: Your First Taste of the Coast
days.body: Slow days between the sea and the spa, with the Hummanaya blow hole nearby.

days.title: The Fort by the Sea
days.body: Explore the iconic Galle Fort, stroll through charming colonial streets, enjoy beautiful beaches, and experience the perfect blend of history, culture, and coastal charm.

days.title: Time to Fly Home
days.body: Private transfer to Colombo airport for your flight home.

stay.name: Private transfer
stay.note: Colombo airport, timed to your flight.

timeAnswer: Nine days covers the hills and the coast without rushing. Shorter trips usually mean dropping a stop rather than moving faster.
